text:
mira: heads up — payment fncall rejects spiked on production route `payment/create` from ~0.8% -> 5.1% in the last 45m. root cause looks like nested object shape: client now sends `billing.contact` without `country_code` (validator expects `country_code` required).

alex: can you paste an example payload? want to see how brittle our validator is.

mira: example below (redacted):
```json
{
  "user_id": "usr_12345",
  "amount": 4200,
  "billing": {
    "contact": {"name": "A. User", "phone": "+1xxx"},
    "method": "card"
  }
}
```
validator error: `billing.contact.country_code: missing required property`

sam: clients started shipping a lib that infers country from IP. product planned to make country optional. Did rollout contain a schema bump?

jordan: product confirms change but asked for a 2-week grace period. question: do we relax the validator, or run a permissive coercion path that fills `country_code` from lookup and flags the request?

luis: ops note: if we auto-fill, we must emit strong telemetry and ensure quota attribution and billing are consistent. Otherwise support will be chasing "why was I charged even though my payload was invalid?"

mira: UX concern — hiding fixes will remove signals about which customers need to upgrade. The console should show original vs coerced payload side-by-side and surface the lookup source (client-provided | heuristic-inferred).

alex: telemetry/metrics proposal: emit metric `fncall.schema_reject.v1` counter for raw rejects, and `fncall.schema_coerced.v1` when coercion path succeeds. Tag both with `route`, `validator_version`, `coercion_strategy` and `coerce_sample_id`. Also instrument `coerce_confidence` as a gauge.

sam: sampling: default sample of 0.5% of coerced events for full payload retention. But when route reject_rate > 2% for 15m, bump sample to 20% for that route until it drops <1% for 30m. This gives us enough examples during spikes.

jordan: agree. For rollouts we should auto-escalate sampling when a validator looseness flag is toggled. i.e., if `validator_rollout=loose` is active, increase sampling to 50% for that rollout cohort for first 48h. Console should auto-create a temporary slice for the rollout (pre/post) and retention 14d by default.

rollout-bot: rollout status -> validator v2.8 staged -> v2.9 (loosen-billing-contact) scheduled. Canary traffic = 10% for `payment/create` route.

luis: billing change: current rule bills when invoke returns success. If we coerce and then succeed, that still counts as success. To keep transparency, we propose: when coercion occurs and we charge, include `x-rwd-invoke-billing: charged; schema_coerced=true; nbilled_tokens=XX` header. For non-billed rejects return `x-rwd-invoke-billing: not_charged; schema_coerced=false`. Also emit trace annotation `billing_decision_source=autobill|manual` in spans.

alex: console UI mock idea: top-level per-request tile with: original payload (collapsed), coerced payload, diff highlights, coercion rationale (e.g., country inferred from IP), validator_version, rollout id, and billing header. Add filter: `schema_coerced=true` and `coercion_strategy=heuristic|accept_enum|fill_missing`

mira: support playbook: when a customer complains about a coerced request, we want to show the exact coerce_sample_id and payload pair. add a one-click link to create a support case with that sample pre-attached.

sam: infra impact: storing full payloads for samples needs retention policy. Keep raw payloads for 30d for sampled coercions; aggregated counters and tags much longer. Need SRE sign-off on storage cost.

luis: I'll draft the RFC: changes to validator service (accept+coerce modes), sampling auto-escalation rules, new metric names/tags, billing header format, rollout integration hooks. Estimate: 3 dev days + 1 day QA + storage opt-in.

ajex: (typo, alex) I'll put up quick console mock by EOD and a small API contract doc for the billing header.

jordan: product will publish guidance to SDK teams to start including `country_code` in next patch, but wants graceful backend behavior for 2 weeks.

mira: action items: luis RFC + spike branch, alex console mock & API contract, sam confirm storage ops numbers with SRE, jordan coordinate product message, rollout-bot will start the staged canary tomorrow at 08:00 UTC. follow-ups in #eng-platform-ops. :white_check_mark:
